remarks: Discover Cozy Elegance at The Village at New Canaan! Welcome to a charming one-bedroom, one-bath condo nestled in one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities. This 743-square-foot home features an inviting open floor plan uniting the living, dining, and kitchen areas. You'll find granite countertops and premium GE and Fisher & Paykel appliances in the kitchen, complemented by hardwood floors throughout.  Admire the elegance of Hubbardton Forge lighting fixtures and enjoy your own private patio for a bit of outdoor relaxation. As a bonus, this home includes a spacious 290-square-foot storage unit on-site, perfect for all your extra belongings.  Just minutes from local shops, dining, and the train station, this condo blends convenience with a touch of luxury. Come see why it's the perfect place to call home.
